description: This file defines a NestJS controller for handling API endpoints related to event types within the 'atoms' module. It includes routes for listing, retrieving, updating, and bulk updating event types, with role and plan guards, and excludes certain endpoints from documentation.

classes.name: AtomsEventTypesController
classes.description: NestJS controller managing event-type related API endpoints for atoms, including listing, retrieving, updating, and bulk operations, with role and plan guards.

methods.name: listEventTypesWithTeam
methods.description: Lists event types associated with a team, accessible via GET /event-types/list-with-team.

methods.name: getPublicEventType
methods.description: Retrieves public details of an event type based on slug and query parameters.

methods.name: getAtomEventType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user event type by ID.

methods.name: listTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Lists event types for a specific team, requires TEAM_ADMIN role and ESSENTIALS plan.

methods.name: listUserEventTypes
methods.description: Lists event types for the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAtomEventTypeApp
methods.description: Retrieves event types app integration details.

methods.name: getUserPaymentInfoById
methods.description: Fetches payment info for a user by UID.

methods.name: bulkUpdateAtomEventTypes
methods.description: Bulk updates default location for multiple event types.

methods.name: bulkUpdateAtomTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Bulk updates default location for team-specific event types, requires role and plan guards.

methods.name: updateAtomEventType
methods.description: Updates a specific event type by ID.

methods.name: updateAtomTeamEventType
methods.description: Updates a team-specific event type, requires role and plan guards.
